title: अष्टाधिकत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks who attained knowledge of liberation without leaving the household life, and Bhishma tells of King Dharmadhvaja Janaka, who had learned from the sage Panchashikha. The female ascetic Sulabha, entering his mind by yoga, questions his claim to freedom, and speaks of his words as without meaning when he still sits as a king.
summary.kn: ಗೃಹಸ್ಥಾಶ್ರಮ ಬಿಡದೆ ಮೋಕ್ಷತತ್ತ್ವ ಪಡೆದವರಾರೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಪಂಚಶಿಖನಿಂದ ಕಲಿತ ರಾಜ ಧರ್ಮಧ್ವಜ ಜನಕನ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯೋಗದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿದ ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಿನಿ ಸುಲಭೆ ಅವನ ಮುಕ್ತಿಯ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನಿಸಿ ರಾಜನಾಗಿ ಕುಳಿತವನ ಮಾತು ಅರ್ಥಹೀನವೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि गृहस्थ जीवन छोड़े बिना मोक्षतत्त्व किसने पाया, और भीष्म पंचशिख से सीखे राजा धर्मध्वज जनक की कथा कहते हैं। योग से उसके मन में प्रविष्ट संन्यासिनी सुलभा उसकी मुक्ति के दावे पर प्रश्न उठाती है और कहती है कि राजा के रूप में बैठे रहते उसकी बातें निरर्थक हैं।
summary.te: గృహస్థ జీవితం విడవకుండా మోక్ష తత్త్వం పొందినవారెవరని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు; పంచశిఖుని వద్ద నేర్చిన రాజు ధర్మధ్వజ జనకుని కథను భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు. యోగంతో అతని మనసులో ప్రవేశించిన సన్యాసిని సులభ అతని ముక్తి వాదనను ప్రశ్నించి, రాజుగా కూర్చున్న అతని మాటలు అర్థరహితమని అంటుంది.
summary.ta: இல்லறத்தை விடாமல் விடுதலைத் தத்துவம் பெற்றவர் யார் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, பஞ்சசிகரிடம் கற்ற மன்னன் தர்மத்வஜ ஜனகனின் கதையைப் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். யோகத்தால் அவன் மனத்தில் புகுந்த பெண் துறவி சுலபை அவன் விடுதலை கூற்றை வினவி, இன்னும் மன்னனாக அமர்ந்திருக்கும்போது அவன் சொற்கள் பொருளற்றவை என்கிறாள்.
summary.ml: ഗൃഹസ്ഥജീവിതം ഉപേക്ഷിക്കാതെ മോക്ഷജ്ഞാനം നേടിയവർ ആരെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; പഞ്ചശിഖനിൽനിന്ന് പഠിച്ച ധർമ്മധ്വജൻ ജനക രാജാവിന്റെ കഥ ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. യോഗത്താൽ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ മനസ്സിൽ പ്രവേശിച്ച സുലഭ എന്ന സ്ത്രീ തപസ്വിനി അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യവാദം ചോദ്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു; അദ്ദേഹം രാജാവായി ഇരിക്കുമ്പോൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ വാക്കുകൾക്ക് അർത്ഥമില്ലെന്ന് അവർ പറയുന്നു.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
अपरित्यज्य गार्हस्थ्यं कुरुराजर्षिसत्तम ।
कः प्राप्तो विनयं बुद्ध्या मोक्षतत्त्वं वदस्व मे ॥

meaning.en: Best of the Kuru royal sages, who, without giving up the householder's life, has attained discipline through understanding and the truth of liberation? Tell me.

verses.text:
संन्यस्यते यथात्मायं संन्यस्तात्मा यथा च यः ।
परं मोक्षस्य यच्चापि तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, tell me how this Self is renounced, how one of renounced self is, and what is the highest of liberation.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
जनकस्य च संवादं सुलभायाश्च भारत ॥

meaning.en: On this they cite an ancient account: the conversation between Janaka and Sulabha, Bharata.

verses.text:
संन्यासफलिकः कश्चिद्बभूव नृपतिः पुरा ।
मैथिलो जनको नाम धर्मध्वज इति श्रुतः ॥

meaning.en: Long ago there was a king who held renunciation as his goal: Janaka of Mithila, known as Dharmadhvaja.

verses.text:
स वेदे मोक्षशास्त्रे च स्वे च शास्त्रे कृतागमः ।
इन्द्रियाणि समाधाय शशास वसुधामिमाम् ॥

meaning.en: He had mastered the Veda, the treatises of liberation and his own royal treatise, and ruled this earth with his senses collected.

verses.text:
तस्य वेदविदः प्राज्ञाः श्रुत्वा तां साधुवृत्तताम् ।
लोकेषु स्पृहयन्त्यन्ये पुरुषाः पुरुषेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: Hearing of his good conduct, Veda-knowing sages and other men in the world, lord of men, admired him.

verses.text:
अथ धर्मयुगे तस्मिन्योगधर्ममनुष्ठिता ।
महीमनुचचारैका सुलभा नाम भिक्षुकी ॥

meaning.en: Then, in that age of dharma, a woman mendicant named Sulabha, devoted to the dharma of Yoga, wandered the earth alone.

verses.text:
तया जगदिदं सर्वमटन्त्या मिथिलेश्वरः ।
तत्र तत्र श्रुतो मोक्षे कथ्यमानस्त्रिदण्डिभिः ॥

meaning.en: As she roamed this whole world, she heard here and there from triple-staffed ascetics the lord of Mithila spoken of as liberated.

verses.text:
सा सुसूक्ष्मां कथां श्रुत्वा तथ्यं नेति ससंशया ।
दर्शने जातसंकल्पा जनकस्य बभूव ह ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that very subtle report and doubting whether it was true, she resolved to see Janaka.

verses.text:
ततः सा विप्रहायाथ पूर्वरूपं हि योगतः ।
अबिभ्रदनवद्याङ्गी रूपमन्यदनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, through Yoga, she gave up her former form and took another, blameless in every limb and supreme in beauty.

verses.text:
चक्षुर्निमेषमात्रेण लघ्वस्त्रगतिगामिनी ।
विदेहानां पुरीं सुभ्रूर्जगाम कमलेक्षणा ॥

meaning.en: In the twinkling of an eye, moving as swiftly as an arrow, the fair-browed, lotus-eyed woman went to the city of the Videhas.

verses.text:
सा प्राप्य मिथिलां रम्यां समृद्धजनसंकुलाम् ।
भैक्षचर्यापदेशेन ददर्श मिथिलेश्वरम् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching delightful Mithila, crowded with prosperous people, she saw the lord of Mithila under the pretext of going about for alms.

verses.text:
राजा तस्याः परं दृष्ट्वा सौकुमार्यं वपुस्तथा ।
केयं कस्य कुतो वेति बभूवागतविस्मयः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing her surpassing delicacy and form, the king was struck with wonder: "Who is she, whose, and from where?"

verses.text:
ततोऽस्याः स्वागतं कृत्वा व्यादिश्य च वरासनम् ।
पूजितां पादशौचेन वरान्नेनाप्यतर्पयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then he welcomed her, offered her a fine seat, honored her with water for the feet, and satisfied her with excellent food.

verses.text:
अथ भुक्तवती प्रीता राजानं मन्त्रिभिर्वृतम् ।
सर्वभाष्यविदां मध्ये चोदयामास भिक्षुकी ॥

meaning.en: When she had eaten and was pleased, the mendicant spurred the king, surrounded by ministers, in the midst of those who know all commentaries.

verses.text:
सुलभा त्वस्य धर्मेषु मुक्तो नेति ससंशया ।
सत्त्वं सत्त्वेन योगज्ञा प्रविवेश महीपते ॥

meaning.en: Doubting whether he was liberated in his dharma, Sulabha, skilled in Yoga, entered the king's mind with her own mind, lord of the earth.

verses.text:
नेत्राभ्यां नेत्रयोरस्य रश्मीन्संयोज्य रश्मिभिः ।
सा स्म संचोदयिष्यन्तं योगबन्धैर्बबन्ध ह ॥

meaning.en: With her eyes she joined the rays of his eyes to her own rays, and when he was about to question her, she bound him with the bonds of Yoga.

verses.text:
जनकोऽप्युत्स्मयन्राजा भावमस्या विशेषयन् ।
प्रतिजग्राह भावेन भावमस्या नृपोत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: King Janaka, smiling, and distinguishing her state, the best of kings answered her state with his own.

verses.text:
तदेकस्मिन्नधिष्ठाने संवादः श्रूयतामयम् ।
छत्रादिषु विमुक्तस्य मुक्तायाश्च त्रिदण्डके ॥

meaning.en: Hear this conversation held in one place, between the one free of parasol and other insignia, and the liberated woman with her triple staff.

verses.text:
भगवत्याः क्व चर्येयं कृता क्व च गमिष्यसि ।
कस्य च त्वं कुतो वेति पप्रच्छैनां महीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: The king asked her: "Where, venerable one, have you been practicing this way of life, where will you go, whose are you, and from where?"

verses.text:
श्रुते वयसि जातौ च सद्भावो नाधिगम्यते ।
एष्वर्थेषूत्तरं तस्मात्प्रवेद्यं सत्समागमे ॥

meaning.en: "Truth is not found in learning, age or birth; so in these matters an answer is to be given in the company of the good."

verses.text:
छत्रादिषु विशेषेषु मुक्तं मां विद्धि सर्वशः ।
स त्वां संमन्तुमिच्छामि मानार्हासि मता हि मे ॥

meaning.en: "Know me as wholly free of parasols and other distinctions; I wish to honor you, for I consider you worthy of honor."

verses.text:
यस्माच्चैतन्मया प्राप्तं ज्ञानं वैशेषिकं पुरा ।
यस्य नान्यः प्रवक्तास्ति मोक्षे तमपि मे शृणु ॥

meaning.en: "And hear also about how I obtained that special knowledge long ago, of which there is no other teacher, concerning liberation."

verses.text:
पाराशर्यसगोत्रस्य वृद्धस्य सुमहात्मनः ।
भिक्षोः पञ्चशिखस्याहं शिष्यः परमसंमतः ॥

meaning.en: "I am the most-favored pupil of the old, great-souled mendicant Panchashikha, of the Parasharya lineage."

verses.text:
सांख्यज्ञाने तथा योगे महीपालविधौ तथा ।
त्रिविधे मोक्षधर्मेऽस्मिन्गताध्वा छिन्नसंशयः ॥

meaning.en: "In Sankhya knowledge, in Yoga, and in the rules for kings, in this threefold dharma of liberation, he had reached the end of the road and had his doubts cut."

verses.text:
स यथाशास्त्रदृष्टेन मार्गेणेह परिव्रजन् ।
वार्षिकांश्चतुरो मासान्पुरा मयि सुखोषितः ॥

meaning.en: "Wandering here by the path seen in the treatises, he once lived happily with me for the four months of the rains."

verses.text:
तेनाहं सांख्यमुख्येन सुदृष्टार्थेन तत्त्वतः ।
श्रावितस्त्रिविधं मोक्षं न च राज्याद्विचालितः ॥

meaning.en: "By that foremost Sankhya, who saw the meaning truly, I was taught the threefold liberation, yet I was not moved from my kingdom."

verses.text:
सोऽहं तामखिलां वृत्तिं त्रिविधां मोक्षसंहिताम् ।
मुक्तरागश्चराम्येकः पदे परमके स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: "So I, free of attachment, move alone, following that whole threefold way joined with liberation, standing in the highest state."

verses.text:
वैराग्यं पुनरेतस्य मोक्षस्य परमो विधिः ।
ज्ञानादेव च वैराग्यं जायते येन मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: "Detachment is the highest rule of this liberation, and detachment is born of knowledge alone, by which one is freed."

verses.text:
ज्ञानेन कुरुते यत्नं यत्नेन प्राप्यते महत् ।
महद्द्वंद्वप्रमोक्षाय सा सिद्धिर्या वयोतिगा ॥

meaning.en: "Through knowledge one makes effort, through effort the great is obtained; that perfection which goes beyond age is for freedom from the great pairs."

verses.text:
सेयं परमिका बुद्धिः प्राप्ता निर्द्वंद्वता मया ।
इहैव गतमोहेन चरता मुक्तसङ्गिना ॥

meaning.en: "This supreme understanding, freedom from pairs, I have attained, living right here with delusion gone and attachments released."

verses.text:
यथा क्षेत्रं मृदूभूतमद्भिराप्लावितं तथा ।
जनयत्यङ्कुरं कर्म नृणां तद्वत्पुनर्भवम् ॥

meaning.en: "As a field made soft and flooded with water brings forth a sprout, so does the action of men bring forth rebirth."

verses.text:
यथा चोत्तापितं बीजं कपाले यत्र तत्र वा ।
प्राप्याप्यङ्कुरहेतुत्वमबीजत्वान्न जायते ॥

meaning.en: "As a seed roasted in a pot or elsewhere, though it gets the cause of sprouting, does not sprout because it is no longer a seed..."

verses.text:
तद्वद्भगवता तेन शिखाप्रोक्तेन भिक्षुणा ।
ज्ञानं कृतमबीजं मे विषयेषु न जायते ॥

meaning.en: "...so by the venerable mendicant Shikha's teaching, knowledge has made me seedless, and it does not sprout in the objects of the senses."

verses.text:
नाभिषज्जति कस्मिंश्चिन्नानर्थे न परिग्रहे ।
नाभिरज्यति चैतेषु व्यर्थत्वाद्रागदोषयोः ॥

meaning.en: "I cling to nothing, neither to harm nor to possession, and I take no pleasure in these, since passion and fault are alike pointless."

verses.text:
यश्च मे दक्षिणं बाहुं चन्दनेन समुक्षयेत् ।
सव्यं वास्या च यस्तक्षेत्समावेतावुभौ मम ॥

meaning.en: "If someone were to anoint my right arm with sandal paste and another were to cut my left with an axe, both would be the same to me."

verses.text:
सुखी सोऽहमवाप्तार्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ।
मुक्तसङ्गः स्थितो राज्ये विशिष्टोऽन्यैस्त्रिदण्डिभिः ॥

meaning.en: "Happy, with my aim achieved, seeing clod, stone and gold as equal, free of attachment, I stay in the kingdom, better than other triple-staffed ascetics."

verses.text:
मोक्षे हि त्रिविधा निष्ठा दृष्टा पूर्वैर्महर्षिभिः ।
ज्ञानं लोकोत्तरं यच्च सर्वत्यागश्च कर्मणाम् ॥

meaning.en: "The ancient great sages saw a threefold basis in liberation: knowledge that is beyond the world, and the abandonment of all actions..."

verses.text:
ज्ञाननिष्ठां वदन्त्येके मोक्षशास्त्रविदो जनाः ।
कर्मनिष्ठां तथैवान्ये यतयः सूक्ष्मदर्शिनः ॥

meaning.en: "Some who know the treatises of liberation speak of devotion to knowledge, others, subtle-seeing ascetics, of devotion to action."

verses.text:
प्रहायोभयमप्येतज्ज्ञानं कर्म च केवलम् ।
तृतीयेयं समाख्याता निष्ठा तेन महात्मना ॥

meaning.en: "And that great-souled one taught a third basis, abandoning both knowledge and action alone."

verses.text:
यमे च नियमे चैव द्वेषे कामे परिग्रहे ।
माने दम्भे तथा स्नेहे सदृशास्ते कुटुम्बिभिः ॥

meaning.en: "In restraint and observance, in hatred, desire, possession, pride, vanity and affection, they are the same as householders."

verses.text:
त्रिदण्डादिषु यद्यस्ति मोक्षो ज्ञानेन केनचित् ।
छत्रादिषु कथं न स्यात्तुल्यहेतौ परिग्रहे ॥

meaning.en: "If there is liberation through some knowledge among triple-staffed ascetics, why not among those with parasols and the like, since possession has the same cause?"

verses.text:
येन येन हि यस्यार्थः कारणेनेह कस्यचित् ।
तत्तदालम्बते द्रव्यं सर्वः स्वे स्वे परिग्रहे ॥

meaning.en: "For whatever reason anyone has some need, he takes hold of that thing; everyone clings to his own possession."

verses.text:
दोषदर्शी तु गार्हस्थ्ये यो व्रजत्याश्रमान्तरम् ।
उत्सृजन्परिगृह्णंश्च सोऽपि सङ्गान्न मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: "One who sees fault in the householder's life and goes to another stage, giving up and taking, is also not freed from attachments."

verses.text:
आधिपत्ये तथा तुल्ये निग्रहानुग्रहात्मनि ।
राजर्षिभिक्षुकाचार्या मुच्यन्ते केन हेतुना ॥

meaning.en: "Where lordship is equal, consisting of punishment and favor, by what reason are royal sages, mendicants and teachers freed?"

verses.text:
अथ सत्याधिपत्येऽपि ज्ञानेनैवेह केवलम् ।
मुच्यन्ते किं न मुच्यन्ते पदे परमके स्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: "Or if truly even in lordship one is freed only by knowledge, are those standing in the highest state not freed?"

verses.text:
काषायधारणं मौण्ड्यं त्रिविष्टब्धः कमण्डलुः ।
लिङ्गान्यत्यर्थमेतानि न मोक्षायेति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: "Wearing ochre, a shaved head, a triple staff and a water pot: these are mere signs, and in my view not for liberation."

verses.text:
यदि सत्यपि लिङ्गेऽस्मिञ्ज्ञानमेवात्र कारणम् ।
निर्मोक्षायेह दुःखस्य लिङ्गमात्रं निरर्थकम् ॥

meaning.en: "If even with this mark knowledge alone is the cause here, then the mark is pointless for release from suffering."

verses.text:
अथ वा दुःखशैथिल्यं वीक्ष्य लिङ्गे कृता मतिः ।
किं तदेवार्थसामान्यं छत्रादिषु न लक्ष्यते ॥

meaning.en: "Or if the mind is set on the mark by seeing a loosening of suffering, is that same common purpose not seen in parasols and the like?"

verses.text:
आकिंचन्ये न मोक्षोऽस्ति कैंचन्ये नास्ति बन्धनम् ।
कैंचन्ये चेतरे चैव जन्तुर्ज्ञानेन मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: "There is no liberation in having nothing, nor bondage in having something; whether with or without possessions, a being is freed by knowledge."

verses.text:
तस्माद्धर्मार्थकामेषु तथा राज्यपरिग्रहे ।
बन्धनायतनेष्वेषु विद्ध्यबन्धे पदे स्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: "So, in dharma, wealth and desire, and in holding a kingdom, in all these seats of bondage, know me as standing in the state without bonds."

verses.text:
राज्यैश्वर्यमयः पाशः स्नेहायतनबन्धनः ।
मोक्षाश्मनिशितेनेह छिन्नस्त्यागासिना मया ॥

meaning.en: "The noose made of kingship and lordship, with its seat in affection, I have cut here with the sword of renunciation, sharpened on the stone of liberation."

verses.text:
सोऽहमेवंगतो मुक्तो जातास्थस्त्वयि भिक्षुकि ।
अयथार्थो हि ते वर्णो वक्ष्यामि शृणु तन्मम ॥

meaning.en: "So, mendicant, being free and having come to trust in you, I shall say that your appearance is not as it truly is; listen to me."

verses.text:
सौकुमार्यं तथा रूपं वपुरग्र्यं तथा वयः ।
तवैतानि समस्तानि नियमश्चेति संशयः ॥

meaning.en: "Delicacy, beauty, a lovely form and youth: all these are yours, and so there is doubt about any vow."

verses.text:
यच्चाप्यननुरूपं ते लिङ्गस्यास्य विचेष्टितम् ।
मुक्तोऽयं स्यान्न वेत्यस्माद्धर्षितो मत्परिग्रहः ॥

meaning.en: "And as your conduct does not suit this mark, I wonder whether you are liberated or not; thus my possession is disturbed."

verses.text:
न च कामसमायुक्ते मुक्तेऽप्यस्ति त्रिदण्डकम् ।
न रक्ष्यते त्वया चेदं न मुक्तस्यास्ति गोपना ॥

meaning.en: "For one liberated there is no triple staff, nor one joined with desire, nor is there protection; and you do not guard this, for the liberated has no guarding."

verses.text:
मत्पक्षसंश्रयाच्चायं शृणु यस्ते व्यतिक्रमः ।
आश्रयन्त्याः स्वभावेन मम पूर्वपरिग्रहम् ॥

meaning.en: "Hear what offense you have committed by taking my side: you took shelter, by nature, of my former holding."

verses.text:
प्रवेशस्ते कृतः केन मम राष्ट्रे पुरे तथा ।
कस्य वा संनिसर्गात्त्वं प्रविष्टा हृदयं मम ॥

meaning.en: "By whom was your entry made into my kingdom and city, and by whose contact did you enter my heart?"

verses.text:
वर्णप्रवरमुख्यासि ब्राह्मणी क्षत्रियो ह्यहम् ।
नावयोरेकयोगोऽस्ति मा कृथा वर्णसंकरम् ॥

meaning.en: "You are chief among the best castes, a brahmin woman, and I am a kshatriya; there can be no union of us two; do not make a mixing of castes."

verses.text:
वर्तसे मोक्षधर्मेषु गार्हस्थ्ये त्वहमाश्रमे ।
अयं चापि सुकष्टस्ते द्वितीयोऽऽश्रमसंकरः ॥

meaning.en: "You live in the dharma of liberation, and I in the householder's stage; this too is a painful second mixing, of stages."

verses.text:
सगोत्रां वासगोत्रां वा न वेद त्वां न वेत्थ माम् ।
सगोत्रमाविशन्त्यास्ते तृतीयो गोत्रसंकरः ॥

meaning.en: "You do not know whether I am of your lineage or not; entering one of the same lineage is a third mixing, of lineage."

verses.text:
अथ जीवति ते भर्ता प्रोषितोऽप्यथ वा क्वचित् ।
अगम्या परभार्येति चतुर्थो धर्मसंकरः ॥

meaning.en: "And if your husband is alive, or away somewhere, a wife of another is not to be approached; this is the fourth mixing, of dharma."

verses.text:
सा त्वमेतान्यकार्याणि कार्यापेक्षा व्यवस्यसि ।
अविज्ञानेन वा युक्ता मिथ्याज्ञानेन वा पुनः ॥

meaning.en: "You are doing these forbidden things as if for some purpose, through ignorance or false knowledge."

verses.text:
अथ वापि स्वतन्त्रासि स्वदोषेणेह केनचित् ।
यदि किंचिच्छ्रुतं तेऽस्ति सर्वं कृतमनर्थकम् ॥

meaning.en: "Or if you are independent here through some fault of your own, then if you have learned anything, all of it is wasted."

verses.text:
इदमन्यत्तृतीयं ते भावस्पर्शविघातकम् ।
दुष्टाया लक्ष्यते लिङ्गं प्रवक्तव्यं प्रकाशितम् ॥

meaning.en: "This third mark of yours, which blocks the touch of feeling, is seen as the sign of a wicked woman; it must be told and made plain."

verses.text:
न मय्येवाभिसंधिस्ते जयैषिण्या जये कृतः ।
येयं मत्परिषत्कृत्स्ना जेतुमिच्छसि तामपि ॥

meaning.en: "Your intent is not on me alone: wishing for victory, you aim at conquest; and you want to conquer this whole assembly of mine."

verses.text:
तथा ह्येवं पुनश्च त्वं दृष्टिं स्वां प्रतिमुञ्चसि ।
मत्पक्षप्रतिघाताय स्वपक्षोद्भावनाय च ॥

meaning.en: "So again you set your view against mine, to strike at my side and to raise your own."

verses.text:
सा स्वेनामर्षजेन त्वमृद्धिमोहेन मोहिता ।
भूयः सृजसि योगास्त्रं विषामृतमिवैकधा ॥

meaning.en: "Deluded by your own resentment-born delusion of prosperity, you again hurl the weapon of Yoga, like poison and nectar mixed into one."

verses.text:
इच्छतोर्हि द्वयोर्लाभः स्त्रीपुंसोरमृतोपमः ।
अलाभश्चाप्यरक्तस्य सोऽत्र दोषो विषोपमः ॥

meaning.en: "When a man and a woman both desire, the gain is like nectar; but for the one without love, the lack of it is a fault like poison."

verses.text:
मा स्प्राक्षीः साधु जानीष्व स्वशास्त्रमनुपालय ।
कृतेयं हि विजिज्ञासा मुक्तो नेति त्वया मम ।
एतत्सर्वं प्रतिच्छन्नं मयि नार्हसि गूहितुम् ॥

meaning.en: "Do not touch me; understand well and follow your own treatise. This inquiry, 'Is he liberated or not?', was made by you about me; all this hidden design you should not conceal from me."

verses.text:
सा यदि त्वं स्वकार्येण यद्यन्यस्य महीपतेः ।
तत्त्वं सत्रप्रतिच्छन्ना मयि नार्हसि गूहितुम् ॥

meaning.en: "If you are here on your own business or on another king's, then, hidden in disguise, you should not conceal the truth from me."

verses.text:
न राजानं मृषा गच्छेन्न द्विजातिं कथंचन ।
न स्त्रियं स्त्रीगुणोपेतां हन्युर्ह्येते मृषागताः ॥

meaning.en: "One should never approach a king, a twice-born or a woman of womanly qualities with falsehood, for these destroy those who come to them falsely."

verses.text:
राज्ञां हि बलमैश्वर्यं ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदां बलम् ।
रूपयौवनसौभाग्यं स्त्रीणां बलमनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: "For kings, power is lordship; for knowers of Brahman, the Veda is power; for women, beauty, youth and good fortune are the supreme power."

verses.text:
अत एतैर्बलैरेते बलिनः स्वार्थमिच्छता ।
आर्जवेनाभिगन्तव्या विनाशाय ह्यनार्जवम् ॥

meaning.en: "So one who wants his own aim should approach these powerful ones with honesty, for dishonesty leads to ruin."

verses.text:
सा त्वं जातिं श्रुतं वृत्तं भावं प्रकृतिमात्मनः ।
कृत्यमागमने चैव वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः ॥

meaning.en: "So you should tell me truly your birth, learning, conduct, feeling, nature, and your purpose in coming."

verses.text:
इत्येतैरसुखैर्वाक्यैरयुक्तैरसमञ्जसैः ।
प्रत्यादिष्टा नरेन्द्रेण सुलभा न व्यकम्पत ॥

meaning.en: Though the king rebuffed her with such unpleasant, unfitting and inconsistent words, Sulabha did not tremble.

verses.text:
उक्तवाक्ये तु नृपतौ सुलभा चारुदर्शना ।
ततश्चारुतरं वाक्यं प्रचक्रामाथ भाषितुम् ॥

meaning.en: When the king had spoken, lovely Sulabha then began to speak still more charming words.

verses.text:
नवभिर्नवभिश्चैव दोषैर्वाग्बुद्धिदूषणैः ।
अपेतमुपपन्नार्थमष्टादशगुणान्वितम् ॥

meaning.en: "Speech is said to be free of nine and nine faults that spoil words and thought, endowed with eighteen merits, with meaning that fits..."

verses.text:
सौक्ष्म्यं संख्याक्रमौ चोभौ निर्णयः सप्रयोजनः ।
पञ्चैतान्यर्थजातानि वाक्यमित्युच्यते नृप ॥

meaning.en: "...subtlety, number, sequence, decision and purpose: these five things make up a statement, king."

verses.text:
एषामेकैकशोऽर्थानां सौक्ष्म्यादीनां सुलक्षणम् ।
शृणु संसार्यमाणानां पदार्थैः पदवाक्यतः ॥

meaning.en: "Hear the clear mark of each of these, subtlety and the rest, as they are brought together by the meanings of words and sentences."

verses.text:
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयेषु भिन्नेषु यथाभेदेन वर्तते ।
तत्रातिशयिनी बुद्धिस्तत्सौक्ष्म्यमिति वर्तते ॥

meaning.en: "Where knowledge works in various objects of knowledge according to their differences, the exceeding keenness of understanding there is called subtlety."

verses.text:
दोषाणां च गुणानां च प्रमाणं प्रविभागशः ।
कंचिदर्थमभिप्रेत्य सा संख्येत्युपधार्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: "The measure of faults and merits in their divisions, for some intended purpose, should be understood as number."

verses.text:
इदं पूर्वमिदं पश्चाद्वक्तव्यं यद्विवक्षितम् ।
क्रमयोगं तमप्याहुर्वाक्यं वाक्यविदो जनाः ॥

meaning.en: "What is meant to be said, this first and that later: those who know speech call that, too, arrangement of sequence."

verses.text:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षेषु प्रतिज्ञाय विशेषतः ।
इदं तदिति वाक्यान्ते प्रोच्यते स विनिर्णयः ॥

meaning.en: "Having stated one's thesis especially regarding dharma, wealth, desire and liberation, saying 'this is that' at the end is called decision."

verses.text:
इच्छाद्वेषभवैर्दुःखैः प्रकर्षो यत्र जायते ।
तत्र या नृपते वृत्तिस्तत्प्रयोजनमिष्यते ॥

meaning.en: "Where suffering born of desire and hatred reaches its height, the course of action there is held to be the purpose."

verses.text:
तान्येतानि यथोक्तानि सौक्ष्म्यादीनि जनाधिप ।
एकार्थसमवेतानि वाक्यं मम निशामय ॥

meaning.en: "These, subtlety and the rest, as described, are joined in one meaning, king of men; hear my statement."

verses.text:
उपेतार्थमभिन्नार्थं नापवृत्तं न चाधिकम् ।
नाश्लक्ष्णं न च संदिग्धं वक्ष्यामि परमं तव ॥

meaning.en: "I shall tell you the highest, with full meaning, undivided in meaning, not rambling or excessive, not rough or doubtful."

verses.text:
न गुर्वक्षरसंबद्धं पराङ्मुखमुखं न च ।
नानृतं न त्रिवर्गेण विरुद्धं नाप्यसंस्कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: "Not tied to heavy syllables, not turned away, not false, not contrary to the three aims, and not unrefined."

verses.text:
न न्यूनं कष्टशब्दं वा व्युत्क्रमाभिहितं न च ।
न शेषं नानुकल्पेन निष्कारणमहेतुकम् ॥

meaning.en: "Not deficient, not with harsh words, not spoken out of order, not leaving something over, not by mere substitution, nor without reason or cause."

verses.text:
कामात्क्रोधाद्भयाल्लोभाद्दैन्यादानार्यकात्तथा ।
ह्रीतोऽनुक्रोशतो मानान्न वक्ष्यामि कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: "I shall never speak from desire, anger, fear, greed, wretchedness, ignobility, shame, pity or pride."

verses.text:
वक्ता श्रोता च वाक्यं च यदा त्वविकलं नृप ।
सममेति विवक्षायां तदा सोऽर्थः प्रकाशते ॥

meaning.en: "When, king, the speaker, the hearer and the speech are all complete and meet equally in the wish to speak, then the meaning shines."

verses.text:
वक्तव्ये तु यदा वक्ता श्रोतारमवमन्यते ।
स्वार्थमाह परार्थं वा तदा वाक्यं न रोहति ॥

meaning.en: "But when the speaker, in a matter to be told, despises the hearer, whether he speaks for himself or another, the speech does not take root."

verses.text:
अथ यः स्वार्थमुत्सृज्य परार्थं प्राह मानवः ।
विशङ्का जायते तस्मिन्वाक्यं तदपि दोषवत् ॥

meaning.en: "And when someone gives up his own interest and speaks for another's, suspicion arises about him, and that speech too is faulty."

verses.text:
यस्तु वक्ता द्वयोरर्थमविरुद्धं प्रभाषते ।
श्रोतुश्चैवात्मनश्चैव स वक्ता नेतरो नृप ॥

meaning.en: "But the speaker who states what is not against the interests of both the hearer and himself is the speaker, and no other, king."

verses.text:
तदर्थवदिदं वाक्यमुपेतं वाक्यसंपदा ।
अविक्षिप्तमना राजन्नेकाग्रः श्रोतुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: "This speech is full of meaning, endowed with the wealth of speech; king, you should listen with an undistracted, one-pointed mind."

verses.text:
कासि कस्य कुतो वेति त्वयाहमभिचोदिता ।
तत्रोत्तरमिदं वाक्यं राजन्नेकमनाः शृणु ॥

meaning.en: "You pressed me with 'Who are you, whose, from where?' Hear the answer to that, king, with a single mind."

verses.text:
यथा जतु च काष्ठं च पांसवश्चोदबिन्दुभिः ।
सुश्लिष्टानि तथा राजन्प्राणिनामिह संभवः ॥

meaning.en: "As lac, wood and dust are firmly joined by drops of water, so, king, is the origin of living beings here."

verses.text:
शब्दः स्पर्शो रसो रूपं गन्धः पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि च ।
पृथगात्मा दशात्मानः संश्लिष्टा जतुकाष्ठवत् ॥

meaning.en: "Sound, touch, taste, form, smell, and the five senses, and the separate Self: the ten selves are joined like lac and wood."

verses.text:
न चैषां चोदना काचिदस्तीत्येष विनिश्चयः ।
एकैकस्येह विज्ञानं नास्त्यात्मनि तथा परे ॥

meaning.en: "It is settled that none of these has any impelling cause; none of them here has knowledge in itself, nor in the others."

verses.text:
न वेद चक्षुश्चक्षुष्ट्वं श्रोत्रं नात्मनि वर्तते ।
तथैव व्यभिचारेण न वर्तन्ते परस्परम् ।
संश्लिष्टा नाभिजायन्ते यथाप इह पांसवः ॥

meaning.en: "The eye does not know its eyeness, nor does the ear abide in itself; likewise they do not act on one another by straying. Joined, they are not born, as dust and water are not here."

verses.text:
बाह्यानन्यानपेक्षन्ते गुणांस्तानपि मे शृणु ।
रूपं चक्षुः प्रकाशश्च दर्शने हेतवस्त्रयः ।
यथैवात्र तथान्येषु ज्ञानज्ञेयेषु हेतवः ॥

meaning.en: "They depend on external things; hear also those qualities. Form, eye and light are three causes of seeing; as here, so in other cases of knowing and the known."

verses.text:
ज्ञानज्ञेयान्तरे तस्मिन्मनो नामापरो गुणः ।
विचारयति येनायं निश्चये साध्वसाधुनी ॥

meaning.en: "Between knowledge and the known there is another quality called mind, by which one weighs good and bad in deciding."

verses.text:
द्वादशस्त्वपरस्तत्र बुद्धिर्नाम गुणः स्मृतः ।
येन संशयपूर्वेषु बोद्धव्येषु व्यवस्यति ॥

meaning.en: "The twelfth quality there is called intellect, by which one decides in matters to be known that begin with doubt."

verses.text:
अथ द्वादशके तस्मिन्सत्त्वं नामापरो गुणः ।
महासत्त्वोऽल्पसत्त्वो वा जन्तुर्येनानुमीयते ॥

meaning.en: "Then in that twelve there is another quality called being, by which a creature is inferred to be of great or small being."

verses.text:
क्षेत्रज्ञ इति चाप्यन्यो गुणस्तत्र चतुर्दशः ।
ममायमिति येनायं मन्यते न च मन्यते ॥

meaning.en: "The fourteenth quality there is another, called the knower of the field, by which one thinks, 'This is mine,' and does not think it."

verses.text:
अथ पञ्चदशो राजन्गुणस्तत्रापरः स्मृतः ।
पृथक्कलासमूहस्य सामग्र्यं तदिहोच्यते ॥

meaning.en: "Then, king, the fifteenth quality is held to be another: the totality of the separate parts, which is spoken of here."

verses.text:
गुणस्त्वेवापरस्तत्र संघात इति षोडशः ।
आकृतिर्व्यक्तिरित्येतौ गुणौ यस्मिन्समाश्रितौ ॥

meaning.en: "And another quality there is the sixteenth, the aggregate, in which these two qualities, shape and manifestation, rest."

verses.text:
सुखदुःखे जरामृत्यू लाभालाभौ प्रियाप्रिये ।
इति चैकोनविंशोऽयं द्वंद्वयोग इति स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: "Pleasure and pain, old age and death, gain and loss, the pleasant and unpleasant: this is the nineteenth, held to be the pairing of opposites."

verses.text:
ऊर्ध्वमेकोनविंशत्याः कालो नामापरो गुणः ।
इतीमं विद्धि विंशत्या भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: "Beyond the nineteen there is another quality called time; by these twenty know the origin and end of beings."

verses.text:
विंशकश्चैष संघातो महाभूतानि पञ्च च ।
सदसद्भावयोगौ च गुणावन्यौ प्रकाशकौ ॥

meaning.en: "The twentieth is the aggregate, and the five great elements; and the two qualities, existence and non-existence, are other illuminating ones."

verses.text:
इत्येवं विंशतिश्चैव गुणाः सप्त च ये स्मृताः ।
विधिः शुक्रं बलं चेति त्रय एते गुणाः परे ॥

meaning.en: "So there are twenty qualities, and seven more are held; method, seed and strength are these three further qualities."

verses.text:
एकविंशश्च दश च कलाः संख्यानतः स्मृताः ।
समग्रा यत्र वर्तन्ते तच्छरीरमिति स्मृतम् ॥

meaning.en: "Twenty-one and ten parts are held to be counted; where they all exist together, that is called the body."

verses.text:
अव्यक्तं प्रकृतिं त्वासां कलानां कश्चिदिच्छति ।
व्यक्तं चासां तथैवान्यः स्थूलदर्शी प्रपश्यति ॥

meaning.en: "Some consider the unmanifest to be the nature of these parts, and another, who sees the gross, sees only the manifest."

verses.text:
अव्यक्तं यदि वा व्यक्तं द्वयीमथ चतुष्टयीम् ।
प्रकृतिं सर्वभूतानां पश्यन्त्यध्यात्मचिन्तकाः ॥

meaning.en: "Whether unmanifest or manifest, in two or in four ways, those who reflect on the Self see the nature of all beings."

verses.text:
सेयं प्रकृतिरव्यक्ता कलाभिर्व्यक्ततां गता ।
अहं च त्वं च राजेन्द्र ये चाप्यन्ये शरीरिणः ॥

meaning.en: "This unmanifest nature has become manifest through the parts, in me and you, king of kings, and in other embodied beings."

verses.text:
बिन्दुन्यासादयोऽवस्थाः शुक्रशोणितसंभवाः ।
यासामेव निपातेन कललं नाम जायते ॥

meaning.en: "The states beginning with the placing of a drop, born from semen and blood, by whose falling the embryo comes to be..."

verses.text:
कललादर्बुदोत्पत्तिः पेशी चाप्यर्बुदोद्भवा ।
पेश्यास्त्वङ्गाभिनिर्वृत्तिर्नखरोमाणि चाङ्गतः ॥

meaning.en: "...from the embryo comes the swelling, from the swelling the flesh, from the flesh the formation of limbs, and from the limbs nails and hair."

verses.text:
संपूर्णे नवमे मासे जन्तोर्जातस्य मैथिल ।
जायते नामरूपत्वं स्त्री पुमान्वेति लिङ्गतः ॥

meaning.en: "In the full ninth month of the born creature, king of Mithila, name and form arise, and female or male is known by the mark."

verses.text:
जातमात्रं तु तद्रूपं दृष्ट्वा ताम्रनखाङ्गुलि ।
कौमाररूपमापन्नं रूपतो नोपलभ्यते ॥

meaning.en: "Seeing the form of one just born, with copper-colored nails and fingers, it is not recognized by looks once it has become a child."

verses.text:
कौमाराद्यौवनं चापि स्थाविर्यं चापि यौवनात् ।
अनेन क्रमयोगेन पूर्वं पूर्वं न लभ्यते ॥

meaning.en: "From childhood comes youth and from youth old age; by this sequence each earlier state is not found again."

verses.text:
कलानां पृथगर्थानां प्रतिभेदः क्षणे क्षणे ।
वर्तते सर्वभूतेषु सौक्ष्म्यात्तु न विभाव्यते ॥

meaning.en: "The separate parts with their separate purposes change moment by moment in all beings, but through subtlety this is not noticed."

verses.text:
न चैषामप्ययो राजँल्लक्ष्यते प्रभवो न च ।
अवस्थायामवस्थायां दीपस्येवार्चिषो गतिः ॥

meaning.en: "King, neither the dissolution nor the origin of these is seen; in each state it is like the passage of a lamp's flame."

verses.text:
तस्याप्येवंप्रभावस्य सदश्वस्येव धावतः ।
अजस्रं सर्वलोकस्य कः कुतो वा न वा कुतः ॥

meaning.en: "With such a nature, running always like a good horse, who, in the whole world, is whose, from where, or from nowhere?"

verses.text:
कस्येदं कस्य वा नेदं कुतो वेदं न वा कुतः ।
संबन्धः कोऽस्ति भूतानां स्वैरप्यवयवैरिह ॥

meaning.en: "Whose is this, or whose is it not? From where is this, or from nowhere? What relation have beings here even with their own limbs?"

verses.text:
यथादित्यान्मणेश्चैव वीरुद्भ्यश्चैव पावकः ।
भवत्येवं समुदयात्कलानामपि जन्तवः ॥

meaning.en: "As fire arises from the sun, from a jewel and from plants, so beings arise from the coming together of the parts."

verses.text:
आत्मन्येवात्मनात्मानं यथा त्वमनुपश्यसि ।
एवमेवात्मनात्मानमन्यस्मिन्किं न पश्यसि ।
यद्यात्मनि परस्मिंश्च समतामध्यवस्यसि ॥

meaning.en: "As you see the Self in the self through the self, why do you not see the self in another through the self? If you hold equality in yourself and in another..."

verses.text:
अथ मां कासि कस्येति किमर्थमनुपृच्छसि ।
इदं मे स्यादिदं नेति द्वंद्वैर्मुक्तस्य मैथिल ।
कासि कस्य कुतो वेति वचने किं प्रयोजनम् ॥

meaning.en: "Then why do you ask me, 'Who are you, whose?' For one freed from pairs, thinking 'may this be mine, not that,' what use is the saying 'Who, whose, from where?'"

verses.text:
रिपौ मित्रेऽथ मध्यस्थे विजये संधिविग्रहे ।
कृतवान्यो महीपाल किं तस्मिन्मुक्तलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: "What mark of liberation is in one who acts toward enemy, friend and neutral, in victory, peace and war?"

verses.text:
त्रिवर्गे सप्तधा व्यक्तं यो न वेदेह कर्मसु ।
सङ्गवान्यस्त्रिवर्गे च किं तस्मिन्मुक्तलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: "What mark of liberation is in one who does not know the three aims, manifest in sevenfold ways, in his actions, and who is attached to the three aims?"

verses.text:
प्रिये चैवाप्रिये चैव दुर्बले बलवत्यपि ।
यस्य नास्ति समं चक्षुः किं तस्मिन्मुक्तलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: "What mark of liberation is in one who has no equal eye for the loved and unloved, the weak and the strong?"

verses.text:
तदमुक्तस्य ते मोक्षे योऽभिमानो भवेन्नृप ।
सुहृद्भिः स निवार्यस्ते विचित्तस्येव भेषजैः ॥

meaning.en: "So if you are not freed, king, the pride you have in liberation should be turned away by friends, as with medicines for one whose mind is deranged."

verses.text:
तानि तान्यनुसंदृश्य सङ्गस्थानान्यरिंदम ।
आत्मनात्मनि संपश्येत्किं तस्मिन्मुक्तलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: "Having seen those various places of attachment, subduer of foes, one should look on them in the self through the self; what mark of liberation is in him?"

verses.text:
इमान्यन्यानि सूक्ष्माणि मोक्षमाश्रित्य कानिचित् ।
चतुरङ्गप्रवृत्तानि सङ्गस्थानानि मे शृणु ॥

meaning.en: "Hear also certain other subtle places of attachment, which arise for one who claims liberation and which proceed in four ways."

verses.text:
य इमां पृथिवीं कृत्स्नामेकच्छत्रां प्रशास्ति ह ।
एकमेव स वै राजा पुरमध्यावसत्युत ॥

meaning.en: "The king who rules this whole earth under one parasol lives in just one city."

verses.text:
तत्पुरे चैकमेवास्य गृहं यदधितिष्ठति ।
गृहे शयनमप्येकं निशायां यत्र लीयते ॥

meaning.en: "In that city he occupies just one house, and in the house one bed, on which he lies down at night."

verses.text:
शय्यार्धं तस्य चाप्यत्र स्त्रीपूर्वमधितिष्ठति ।
तदनेन प्रसङ्गेन फलेनैवेह युज्यते ॥

meaning.en: "Half of that bed too is occupied by a woman first; and so by this connection he is joined here with its result."

verses.text:
एवमेवोपभोगेषु भोजनाच्छादनेषु च ।
गुणेषु परिमेयेषु निग्रहानुग्रहौ प्रति ॥

meaning.en: "Likewise in enjoyments, in food and clothing, in the measured goods, and in punishing and favoring..."

verses.text:
परतन्त्रः सदा राजा स्वल्पे सोऽपि प्रसज्जते ।
संधिविग्रहयोगे च कुतो राज्ञः स्वतन्त्रता ॥

meaning.en: "...the king is always dependent, and he clings even to small things; where is the king's independence in peace and war?"

verses.text:
स्त्रीषु क्रीडाविहारेषु नित्यमस्यास्वतन्त्रता ।
मन्त्रे चामात्यसमितौ कुत एव स्वतन्त्रता ॥

meaning.en: "With women, in play and recreation he is always unfree; how then in counsel and the assembly of ministers?"

verses.text:
यदा त्वाज्ञापयत्यन्यांस्तदास्योक्ता स्वतन्त्रता ।
अवशः कार्यते तत्र तस्मिंस्तस्मिन्गुणे स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: "When he commands others, that is called his independence; yet there he is made to act helplessly, standing in each respective quality."

verses.text:
स्वप्तुकामो न लभते स्वप्तुं कार्यार्थिभिर्जनैः ।
शयने चाप्यनुज्ञातः सुप्त उत्थाप्यतेऽवशः ॥

meaning.en: "Wishing to sleep, he cannot sleep because of people with business; and even when permitted to lie down, he is woken helplessly."

verses.text:
स्नाह्यालभ पिब प्राश जुहुध्यग्नीन्यजेति च ।
वदस्व शृणु चापीति विवशः कार्यते परैः ॥

meaning.en: "'Bathe, anoint, drink, eat, offer to the fires, sacrifice, speak, listen': thus he is made to act helplessly by others."

verses.text:
अभिगम्याभिगम्यैनं याचन्ते सततं नराः ।
न चाप्युत्सहते दातुं वित्तरक्षी महाजनात् ॥

meaning.en: "Men approach him and ask constantly; yet, guarding his wealth, he cannot bring himself to give to the crowd."

verses.text:
दाने कोशक्षयो ह्यस्य वैरं चाप्यप्रयच्छतः ।
क्षणेनास्योपवर्तन्ते दोषा वैराग्यकारकाः ॥

meaning.en: "In giving, his treasury declines; in not giving, enmity arises, and in a moment faults that cause estrangement come upon him."

verses.text:
प्राज्ञाञ्शूरांस्तथैवाढ्यानेकस्थानेऽपि शङ्कते ।
भयमप्यभये राज्ञो यैश्च नित्यमुपास्यते ॥

meaning.en: "He fears the wise, the brave and the rich, even in one place; for the king there is fear even in safety from those who always attend him."

verses.text:
यदा चैते प्रदुष्यन्ति राजन्ये कीर्तिता मया ।
तदैवास्य भयं तेभ्यो जायते पश्य यादृशम् ॥

meaning.en: "When these royal attendants I have named turn bad, see what fear arises for him from them."

verses.text:
सर्वः स्वे स्वे गृहे राजा सर्वः स्वे स्वे गृहे गृही ।
निग्रहानुग्रहौ कुर्वंस्तुल्यो जनक राजभिः ॥

meaning.en: "Every king in his own house and every householder in his own house, exercising punishment and favor, is equal to kings, Janaka."

verses.text:
पुत्रा दारास्तथैवात्मा कोशो मित्राणि संचयः ।
परैः साधारणा ह्येते तैस्तैरेवास्य हेतुभिः ॥

meaning.en: "Sons, wives, one's own self, treasury, friends and stores are shared by others, each for its own reasons."

verses.text:
हतो देशः पुरं दग्धं प्रधानः कुञ्जरो मृतः ।
लोकसाधारणेष्वेषु मिथ्याज्ञानेन तप्यते ॥

meaning.en: "When the land is struck, the city burned, or the chief elephant dead, he suffers through false knowledge over things shared with the world."

verses.text:
अमुक्तो मानसैर्दुःखैरिच्छाद्वेषप्रियोद्भवैः ।
शिरोरोगादिभी रोगैस्तथैव विनिपातिभिः ॥

meaning.en: "Not free from mental sufferings born of desire, hatred and attachment, nor from diseases such as headache and falls..."

verses.text:
द्वंद्वैस्तैस्तैरुपहतः सर्वतः परिशङ्कितः ।
बहुप्रत्यर्थिकं राज्यमुपास्ते गणयन्निशाः ॥

meaning.en: "...struck by this and that pair of opposites, suspected on every side, he serves a kingdom with many rivals, counting the nights."

verses.text:
तदल्पसुखमत्यर्थं बहुदुःखमसारवत् ।
को राज्यमभिपद्येत प्राप्य चोपशमं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: "That has little pleasure, much pain and no substance; who would take up a kingdom, and having it, find peace?"

verses.text:
ममेदमिति यच्चेदं पुरं राष्ट्रं च मन्यसे ।
बलं कोशममात्यांश्च कस्यैतानि न वा नृप ॥

meaning.en: "This city and country you think of as 'mine', the army, treasury and ministers: whose are these, king, or are they not?"

verses.text:
मित्रामात्यं पुरं राष्ट्रं दण्डः कोशो महीपतिः ।
सप्ताङ्गश्चक्रसंघातो राज्यमित्युच्यते नृप ॥

meaning.en: "Friend, minister, city, country, the army, treasury and the king: the sevenfold collection like a wheel is called a kingdom."

verses.text:
सप्ताङ्गस्यास्य राज्यस्य त्रिदण्डस्येव तिष्ठतः ।
अन्योन्यगुणयुक्तस्य कः केन गुणतोऽधिकः ॥

meaning.en: "Among the seven limbs of this kingdom, standing like a triple staff, each with the qualities of the others, which is greater than which?"

verses.text:
तेषु तेषु हि कालेषु तत्तदङ्गं विशिष्यते ।
येन यत्सिध्यते कार्यं तत्प्राधान्याय कल्पते ॥

meaning.en: "At various times one limb or another is excellent; whichever accomplishes the task becomes foremost."

verses.text:
सप्ताङ्गश्चापि संघातस्त्रयश्चान्ये नृपोत्तम ।
संभूय दशवर्गोऽयं भुङ्क्ते राज्यं हि राजवत् ॥

meaning.en: "Best of kings, the seven limbs and three others together make a group of ten, and he enjoys the kingdom like a king."

verses.text:
यश्च राजा महोत्साहः क्षत्रधर्मरतो भवेत् ।
स तुष्येद्दशभागेन ततस्त्वन्यो दशावरैः ॥

meaning.en: "The king of great zeal who delights in kshatriya duty is satisfied with a tenth part, and the others with ten times less."

verses.text:
नास्त्यसाधारणो राजा नास्ति राज्यमराजकम् ।
राज्येऽसति कुतो धर्मो धर्मेऽसति कुतः परम् ॥

meaning.en: "There is no king who is not common to others, and no kingdom without a king; without a kingdom, where is dharma, and without dharma, where is the highest?"

verses.text:
योऽप्यत्र परमो धर्मः पवित्रं राजराज्ययोः ।
पृथिवी दक्षिणा यस्य सोऽश्वमेधो न विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: "And what is the highest dharma here, the purity of king and kingdom, with the earth as its fee, that is the Ashvamedha, which does not exist."

verses.text:
साहमेतानि कर्माणि राज्यदुःखानि मैथिल ।
समर्था शतशो वक्तुमथ वापि सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: "King of Mithila, I could tell hundreds and thousands of such deeds and sorrows of kingship."

verses.text:
स्वदेहे नाभिषङ्गो मे कुतः परपरिग्रहे ।
न मामेवंविधां मुक्तामीदृशं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: "I have no attachment even to my own body; how then to another's possession? Being such and liberated, you should not speak to me thus."

verses.text:
ननु नाम त्वया मोक्षः कृत्स्नः पञ्चशिखाच्छ्रुतः ।
सोपायः सोपनिषदः सोपासङ्गः सनिश्चयः ॥

meaning.en: "Did you not hear the whole of liberation from Panchashikha, with its means, its Upanishad, its supplements and its conclusions?"

verses.text:
तस्य ते मुक्तसङ्गस्य पाशानाक्रम्य तिष्ठतः ।
छत्रादिषु विशेषेषु कथं सङ्गः पुनर्नृप ॥

meaning.en: "For you, free of attachment, standing having trampled the nooses, how can there be attachment again to special things like parasols, king?"

verses.text:
श्रुतं ते न श्रुतं मन्ये मिथ्या वापि श्रुतं श्रुतम् ।
अथ वा श्रुतसंकाशं श्रुतमन्यच्छ्रुतं त्वया ॥

meaning.en: "I think what you have heard has not been heard; or what you heard was false; or something else resembling it was heard by you."

verses.text:
अथापीमासु संज्ञासु लौकिकीषु प्रतिष्ठसि ।
अभिषङ्गावरोधाभ्यां बद्धस्त्वं प्राकृतो यथा ॥

meaning.en: "Or if you stand on these worldly names, you are bound by attachment and confinement, like an ordinary man."

verses.text:
सत्त्वेनानुप्रवेशो हि योऽयं त्वयि कृतो मया ।
किं तवापकृतं तत्र यदि मुक्तोऽसि सर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: "As for my entering you with my mind, what harm did I do to you there, if you are liberated on all sides?"

verses.text:
नियमो ह्येष धर्मेषु यतीनां शून्यवासिता ।
शून्यमावासयन्त्या च मया किं कस्य दूषितम् ॥

meaning.en: "It is a rule of dharma for ascetics to dwell in empty places; in my making an empty place my dwelling, what did I spoil for whom?"

verses.text:
न पाणिभ्यां न बाहुभ्यां पादोरुभ्यां न चानघ ।
न गात्रावयवैरन्यैः स्पृशामि त्वा नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: "Neither with hands nor arms, nor with feet and thighs, nor with other limbs of the body do I touch you, lord of men, sinless one."

verses.text:
कुले महति जातेन ह्रीमता दीर्घदर्शिना ।
नैतत्सदसि वक्तव्यं सद्वासद्वा मिथः कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: "One born in a great family, modest and far-sighted, should not say in an assembly what is good or bad done in private."

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणा गुरवश्चेमे तथामात्या गुरूत्तमाः ।
त्वं चाथ गुरुरप्येषामेवमन्योन्यगौरवम् ॥

meaning.en: "These brahmins are your elders, and the ministers are the highest elders; you too are their elder: such is the mutual respect."

verses.text:
तदेवमनुसंदृश्य वाच्यावाच्यं परीक्षता ।
स्त्रीपुंसोः समवायोऽयं त्वया वाच्यो न संसदि ॥

meaning.en: "So, having considered thus, and weighing what may and may not be said, you should not speak of this union of woman and man in an assembly."

verses.text:
यथा पुष्करपर्णस्थं जलं तत्पर्णसंस्थितम् ।
तिष्ठत्यस्पृशती तद्वत्त्वयि वत्स्यामि मैथिल ॥

meaning.en: "As water on a lotus leaf stays on the leaf without touching it, so shall I dwell in you, king of Mithila."

verses.text:
यदि वाप्यस्पृशन्त्या मे स्पर्शं जानासि कंचन ।
ज्ञानं कृतमबीजं ते कथं तेनेह भिक्षुणा ॥

meaning.en: "Or if you know any touch from me who do not touch, how has knowledge made you seedless, mendicant?"

verses.text:
स गार्हस्थ्याच्च्युतश्च त्वं मोक्षं नावाप्य दुर्विदम् ।
उभयोरन्तराले च वर्तसे मोक्षवातिकः ॥

meaning.en: "You have fallen from the householder's life without reaching hard-to-know liberation, and you stand between the two, a mere talker of liberation."

verses.text:
न हि मुक्तस्य मुक्तेन ज्ञस्यैकत्वपृथक्त्वयोः ।
भावाभावसमायोगे जायते वर्णसंकरः ॥

meaning.en: "For the liberated and the liberated knower, in oneness and separateness, in the union of being and non-being, there is no mixing of castes."

verses.text:
वर्णाश्रमपृथक्त्वे च दृष्टार्थस्यापृथक्त्विनः ।
नान्यदन्यदिति ज्ञात्वा नान्यदन्यत्प्रवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: "In the separateness of castes and stages, for one who sees the matter and is not separate, knowing that one is not other than another, nothing acts as other from another."

verses.text:
पाणौ कुण्डं तथा कुण्डे पयः पयसि मक्षिकाः ।
आश्रिताश्रययोगेन पृथक्त्वेनाश्रया वयम् ॥

meaning.en: "A bowl in the hand, milk in the bowl, flies in the milk: by the relation of support and supported we are separate supports."

verses.text:
न तु कुण्डे पयोभावः पयश्चापि न मक्षिकाः ।
स्वयमेवाश्रयन्त्येते भावा न तु पराश्रयम् ॥

meaning.en: "But the milk is not in the bowl's being, nor are the flies the milk; these states rest on themselves and not on another's support."

verses.text:
पृथक्त्वादाश्रमाणां च वर्णान्यत्वे तथैव च ।
परस्परपृथक्त्वाच्च कथं ते वर्णसंकरः ॥

meaning.en: "Given the separateness of stages and the difference of castes, and their mutual separateness, how is there mixing of castes for you?"

verses.text:
नास्मि वर्णोत्तमा जात्या न वैश्या नावरा तथा ।
तव राजन्सवर्णास्मि शुद्धयोनिरविप्लुता ॥

meaning.en: "I am not of higher caste by birth, nor a vaishya, nor lower; I am of your own caste, king, of pure and unbroken birth."

verses.text:
प्रधानो नाम राजर्षिर्व्यक्तं ते श्रोत्रमागतः ।
कुले तस्य समुत्पन्नां सुलभां नाम विद्धि माम् ॥

meaning.en: "The royal sage named Pradhana has surely come to your ears; know me as Sulabha, born in his family."

verses.text:
द्रोणश्च शतशृङ्गश्च वक्रद्वारश्च पर्वतः ।
मम सत्रेषु पूर्वेषां चिता मघवता सह ॥

meaning.en: "Drona, Shatashringa, Vakradvara and Parvata: in my ancestors' sacrifices their pyres stood with Maghavan."

verses.text:
साहं तस्मिन्कुले जाता भर्तर्यसति मद्विधे ।
विनीता मोक्षधर्मेषु चराम्येका मुनिव्रतम् ॥

meaning.en: "I was born in that family; since there was no husband like me, trained in the dharmas of liberation, I wander alone in the vow of a sage."

verses.text:
नास्मि सत्रप्रतिच्छन्ना न परस्वाभिमानिनी ।
न धर्मसंकरकरी स्वधर्मेऽस्मि धृतव्रता ॥

meaning.en: "I am not hidden in disguise, nor proud of another's property, nor a maker of mixing of dharma; I hold firm to my own dharma."

verses.text:
नास्थिरा स्वप्रतिज्ञायां नासमीक्ष्यप्रवादिनी ।
नासमीक्ष्यागता चाहं त्वत्सकाशं जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: "I am not unsteady in my own vow, nor one who speaks without examining, nor did I come to you without examining, lord of men."

verses.text:
मोक्षे ते भावितां बुद्धिं श्रुत्वाहं कुशलैषिणी ।
तव मोक्षस्य चाप्यस्य जिज्ञासार्थमिहागता ॥

meaning.en: "Having heard of your mind trained in liberation, and wishing you well, I came here to test you and this liberation of yours."

verses.text:
न वर्गस्था ब्रवीम्येतत्स्वपक्षपरपक्षयोः ।
मुक्तो न मुच्यते यश्च शान्तो यश्च न शाम्यति ॥

meaning.en: "I do not say this from partisanship for my side or another's: one who is freed is not freed, and one who is peaceful is not at peace."

verses.text:
यथा शून्ये पुरागारे भिक्षुरेकां निशां वसेत् ।
तथा हि त्वच्छरीरेऽस्मिन्निमां वत्स्यामि शर्वरीम् ॥

meaning.en: "As a mendicant would stay one night in an empty old house, so I shall pass this night in this body of yours."

verses.text:
साहमासनदानेन वागातिथ्येन चार्चिता ।
सुप्ता सुशरणा प्रीता श्वो गमिष्यामि मैथिल ॥

meaning.en: "Honored with the gift of a seat and the hospitality of words, I have slept well, sheltered and content; tomorrow I shall go, king of Mithila."

verses.text:
इत्येतानि स वाक्यानि हेतुमन्त्यर्थवन्ति च ।
श्रुत्वा नाधिजगौ राजा किंचिदन्यदतः परम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing these words, full of reasons and meaning, the king found nothing more to say after that.
